attr.title: Soma Union
attr.desc: Soma Union is a galaxy-spanning RPG that returns to the world of Soma! ...or so it would, if your planet had not been destroyed in a great calamity. As you roam through the cosmos to find the missing fragments of your home world, you'll meet a colorful cast of characters and make important choices that may not be as clear as they seem.
attr.inst: Download from itch.io Steam version does not work due to DRM, then add the game files (Data, Graphics, Audio, Fonts, Game.rgss3a, Game.ini) to the port folder on your device. It will take a moment to patch on first launch.
